brief: Richard of Chichester, born in 1197, was renowned as a scholar, a caring priest and a great administrator. He became Bishop of Chichester in 1244. In a time when standards were slipping badly, Richard reformed his diocese by refusing to allow his priests to follow common practice. Richard was loved by his people. For many years after his death, his tomb at Chichester Cathedral was a popular place of pilgrimage. Richard died in 1253 and was canonised in 1262.
